{{Top|leg}}
'''Glowglitter '''was a decorative paint used in fashion.<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> glowglitter-painted ear helixes were a popular trend among upper-class girls on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]].<ref name="COO" />

When the [[Ferrouz's wife|wife]] and [[Ferrouz's daughter|daughter]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] were abducted by the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], traces of glowglitter were discovered by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the [[palace emergency safe room]] where they had been held temporarily. The find led Jade to conclude that Ferrouz's daughter had been present in the room.<ref name="COO" />
